evidence: SIMULATION logs (MuJoCo 3.10.0, rl/trike_env.py through rl/robustness/sweep.py and the trot's judged and push episodes); DESK geometry (sim/check_packaging60.py's parts via candidate_checks.ClashGeometry)
units: clearance mm (signed; < 0 overlap), angles deg, shares 0-1
cap_note: ClashGeometry reads every clearance up to check_packaging60.CAP_M (50 mm); a value of 50.0 means >= 50 mm. The actual least beyond the cap is bracketed in e1_beyond_cap.json (supporting, added after a result)

rule.REACHED: a clash is REACHED if at least two of the five controllers have a logged pose with clearance < 0 (#9: either side)
rule.ACCEPTABLE: a stop is ACCEPTABLE if, for each of the five controllers separately, the least clearance over all its samples with the stop applied is >= 5 mm and at most 1 % of its samples are clipped
